st_area_profile_hint: Name, time zone and identity of this organisation.
st_area_people_hint: Who appears in the calendar: therapists, reception, staff.
st_area_roles_hint: What each role may see and do.
st_area_services_hint: What is offered, for how long and at what price.
st_area_devices_hint: Equipment that is booked with a session.
st_area_plan_hint: Draw and edit the floor plan.
st_area_online_hint: What visitors may book online, and when.
st_area_feedback_hint: What clients say after a session.
st_area_import_hint: Bring data in from the old application.
st_lead: The settings of this organisation: the team, the services and spaces, the rules and the data.
me_lead: What is yours alone: how the console looks and speaks, how it reaches you, and your sign-in.
pl_lead: The estate's own administration: organisations, who belongs where, and the health of what everything runs on.
pl_integrations_soon: The health of sign-in, authorization, notifications, e-mail, the store and backups appears here once the platform reports it.
me_invalid: Nothing was saved: a value is not right. Check the quiet hours (start and end must differ).
me_locked_hint: Ticked grey boxes cannot be switched off: they are news the team must receive.
me_quiet_hint: The hours are the clinic's. E-mails and the console's list do not stop.
st_org_cui_hint: The fiscal code, with RO in front if the organisation pays VAT.
st_org_https_hint: An address that starts with https://
st_org_phone_main: The first phone is the main one: visitors see it first.
st_org_hours_lead: For each day, the opening and closing time; the second pair is after a break. A day with no times is closed.
st_org_invalid: Some fields are not right: check the phone, e-mail, https addresses, postal code (6 digits), tax ID and times. Nothing was saved.
st_org_stale: Someone else saved the details meanwhile. This is what is saved now; make your change again.
